purpose: Teach: 結びつく/オーディション/去り/今季/真意/一読/一概に/トレーナー

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 地域防犯と、企業の取り組み、結びつくこと、効果的です、皆様の協力、感謝です。
lines.en: Local crime prevention and corporate initiatives work better together. Thank you for your cooperation.
lines.style: Measured, official tone. Slight pause before the summary. Voice carries the weight of protocol without coldness. A genuine thank-you beneath the formality.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、新人警察官、オーディションのような、厳しい選考、あるんですか?
lines.en: I see. Do officers go through a rigorous selection process—like an audition?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, leaning forward slightly. Respectful but engaged. The question feels personal, not just procedural. Slight lift at the end, real interest.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 容疑者、現場を、去り、別の地域に、移動した形跡、ございます、捜査、続けています。
lines.en: The suspect left the scene and appears to have moved to another area. We're continuing our investigation.
lines.style: Factual, even delivery. The information is presented without drama—just the next piece of the case. Quiet confidence in the investigation's direction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。今季の犯罪件数、警察の発表、楽しみに、しております、減少傾向、期待です。
lines.en: I see. We're looking forward to the police department's crime statistics release this season—hoping to see a downward trend.
lines.style: Earnest and slightly formal. The hope is genuine but measured. A small emphasis on 'looking forward,' showing alignment with the officer's work.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 容疑者の真意、取り調べで、見抜く力、警察、求められております。
lines.en: The ability to see through a suspect's true intent during questioning—that's what's really demanded of police work.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly slower. The officer is speaking from hard-won experience. Thoughtful pause before the final phrase, acknowledging the real difficulty of the work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察報告書、社内、一読、徹底するよう、社員に、伝えております。
lines.en: I see. We're making sure our staff thoroughly reviews the police reports you've shared with us internally.
lines.style: Cooperative and attentive. Kenji is demonstrating follow-through—not just listening but acting. Calm, slightly formal register that signals professional respect.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 一概に、防犯対策、画一化、難しいです、地域ごとの特性、考慮、必要です。
lines.en: Crime prevention isn't one-size-fits-all. It's hard to standardize—we need to consider what's specific to each neighborhood.
lines.style: Thoughtful, pedagogical tone. The officer is explaining, not lecturing. Slight emphasis on the word 'specific,' underscoring the nuance. Patient and clear.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察出身のトレーナー、社内、お招きしております、定期的に。
lines.en: I see. We regularly bring in trainers who have a police background to work with our staff internally.
lines.style: Smooth, matter-of-fact. Kenji is calmly demonstrating his company's commitment. No need to oversell—the fact itself speaks. Quiet confidence in the partnership.
